Rodrigo, I am planning the calendar for next year. How often do you have the KPI forum in Brazil?
We have it every month. It is always on the first Tuesday, at ten o'clock.
And the weekly meeting with your team?
It is usually on Monday morning. Sometimes it is on Tuesday, when I travel.
How often do the global teams visit Brazil?
They often come, about six times a year. They never come in December.
Good to know. And do you send the monthly update on Friday?
Yes, I always send it on the last Friday of the month. Sometimes it is late, but only one day.
One day is fine. And your commute? Is it long?
Yes. I usually drive one hour to Alphaville. But I never drive on Friday: I work from home.
I often speak English with the global team.

Hi Rodrigo, this is Tom, from the plant in New Jersey. You asked about our routine. We usually start at seven in the morning. The trucks always arrive at eight, and we never receive material after four in the afternoon. We have a safety meeting every day, and a quality meeting once a week, on Thursday. The team sometimes works on Saturday, but only in busy months. Call me if you have questions. Bye.

Hi Rodrigo, it's Nora, from the New York office. Some information for your visit in October. The office usually opens at eight thirty. People often arrive at nine, and they never have long lunches: lunch is usually thirty minutes, at the desk. On Friday we sometimes finish at three. And the coffee machine is always busy at ten! See you in October.

Every Monday, Rodrigo drives one hour to Alphaville. He usually starts the week with the weekly meeting of his team. On Tuesday he often has a call with Claire in Paris. Once a month he presents the numbers at the KPI forum. On Friday he always sends the update, and he never drives: he works from home.
